facts.text: The sheet is marked 'archived' and is sourced to National Building Code-2019 Alberta Edition, Division B, for spatial separation of a garden suite house.
A garden suite is an accessory dwelling unit on the same property as the principal house, built to the same standard, citing 9.10.15.

Where an attached garage is intended to serve, wholly or partly, the principal house, the garage parking space is separated from the rest of the building by 1 h fire-resistance rated construction to form a separate fire compartment.

Where no other on-site parking is provided, a letter from the property owner may be required to document the garage use intention. Practice is to rate the parking space in the garden suite for future owner changes.

The sheet says to ensure the garden-suite-facing exposing building face of the principal house is detailed in coordination with the house-facing exposing building face of the garden suite, calculated to a deemed limiting distance between the two structures.

For a mutual or shared detached garage offset from the dwelling, the sheet says to detail the garage-facing exposing face of the house per ABC 9.10.15 and coordinate it with the house-facing face of the garage per ABC 9.10.14, calculated to a deemed limiting distance.
The source line directs the reader to 'Refer to NBC-2019AE for exact wording and final determination of compliance'.
